_metadata.description: Reviewed exact catalog safety transitions. Approval eligibility binds the exact baseline catalog SHA-256, product ID and before/after state, and candidate_blob_sha256 for a retained product. The actual candidate blob must match products_core.detail_blob_sha256. Removals bind the baseline and exact prior state plus absence. Whole candidate catalog checksums are historical provenance only. Ordinary score/tier movements are report-only. Reason, reviewer attribution and date are required. Unmatched historical groups may be removed after their baselines are no longer current.

approvals.reason: Exact image-complete catalog 2026.11.02.011254 source corrections, reviewed under Sean's current instruction to verify, correct, integrate and release. Actual source review was performed by Codex and independently checked by a second agent; this does not claim a Sean/Dr Pham/PharmD source certification. NIH original panels establish: 273629 folic acid 100/200 mcg and biotin 37.5/75 mcg, not API milligrams; 64433 and 64821 vitamin D 800 IU, not 800 mg; 78327 iodine 150 mcg, not 18 mg, and N-Acetyl-L-Cystine 15 mg, not N-acetylcysteine. The removed rules concern those erroneous dose/identity attributions only. Original PDFs and exact label/override mappings were independently checked; actual candidate blobs retain identical allergens and all other warning identities against checksum-verified baseline blobs. Product 78327 remains Not Scored with null public quality score and tier. No threshold, preparation equivalence, efficacy credit, ban/recall policy or safety clearance is introduced. NO_KNOWN_CATALOG_CONCERN means no remaining catalog-level signal in the current rule set, never safe for every person; personalized medication, condition, pregnancy, breastfeeding and allergy warnings remain independently applicable. This record covers only these four exact before/after states and the stated full baseline/candidate hashes. All remaining source, export, interaction, live-comparison and Flutter gates remain mandatory; any changed candidate or states must be reviewed again.
